responsibility: Implements TILEPro’s common target configuration for GCC’s generic option machinery by defining the target-specific optimization-default table and option-structure initialization used before the main backend runs. In particular it enables both instruction-scheduling passes at -O1 because scheduling and bundling are central to TILEPro performance, turns on asynchronous unwind tables in gcc_options, and instantiates targetm_common without the extra default-flag override present in the TILE-Gx companion.
